template: Paint a finished picture of: {subject}. Use the line sketch as a pose and layout guide: each figure and object goes in the same position and pose as in the sketch. A stick figure is a pose guide for a person with natural proportions; its circle marks the head and its lines mark the torso, arms and legs. The guide lines themselves are not part of the picture.
